Priya Rao: heads-up — customer A asked if we can offer predictive burst caps so their critical endpoints don't get throttled during marketing spikes. can we sketch feasibility?
Devon Lee: are they asking for guaranteed extra GPUs or just soft burst headroom?
Priya Rao: soft headroom + automatic shaping. they'd like guaranteed latency for top-tier routes during spikes for 90-day windows.
Michael Chen: this is basically per-tenant predictive allocation + temporary priority bump. tricky for autoscale because of preemption and dedicated pool math.
Sara Patel: question — do they need billing changes? predictive reserve implies reserved cost model or pre-purchased credits.
Priya Rao: they want a model where credits auto-draw when predicted peak > booked capacity. think "burst credits" rather than new reservation.
Devon Lee: implementation idea: use a prediction signal (24h rolling 95th) + immediate short-term smoothing to provision soft headroom. add two guardrails: (1) soft cap (no routing drop, degraded perf) (2) hard cap (enforce preemption)
Michael Chen: agreeing. rough config prototype: 
```
burst_policy: 
  credit_pool: tenant_credits
  lookback: 24h
  percentile: 95
  smoothing_window: 5m
  soft_headroom_pct: 30
  hard_headroom_pct: 75
  fallback_model: smaller-quantized-variant
```
Devon Lee: nice. add explicit SLA window schedule so oncall knows when spikes are expected (e.g., marketing push 10:00-12:00). ops-bot should create incidents when prediction crosses hard_headroom.
ops-bot: noted — will create "predictive-burst-alert" when predicted_usage >= hard_headroom_pct for 10m.
Sara Patel: for billing, propose: charge usage against credits first, then bill overage at premium rate. product needs to document tradeoffs.
Priya Rao: launch criteria proposal: (1) policy applied to 2 pilot customers (2) e2e telemetry for predicted vs actual error <15% (3) graceful fallback tested (fallback_model lat increase <2x)
Michael Chen: dev tasks: metric plumbing (predictor -> autoscaler), config UI in console, route-level tags to opt-in tenants. estimate 3 sprints.
Devon Lee: risk: aggressive soft_headroom can starve best-effort pools. mitigation: global spillover budget and per-region caps. add canary release to 10% of traffic.
Sara Patel: customer comms: need clear doc + pricing language, also contract change for SLAs. I'll draft copy after pilot signals.
Priya Rao: action items: Devon create RFC for autoscale changes, Michael wire predictor signal and simple dashboard, Sara draft pricing + legal hooks. I'll run pilot prioritization with CS.
Devon Lee: ping me when RFC is ready, I'll add failure-mode diagrams.
ops-bot: reminder set for 3d to check RFC draft status. :calendar:
__note: Each message prefixed with name. No title field per agents.md.
